title: Name Dennis Mariani confirmed by someone at the Nevada Test Site

tellings.quote: And I know of one instance in which the name Dennis Mariani was corroborated by somebody at you know, Nevada test site.

plain: Michels says he knows of one case where someone at the Nevada Test Site, the US government's nuclear testing ground in the Nevada desert, confirmed the name Dennis Mariani, a name that is part of the story of Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site there in the late 1980s. Michels tells this himself without saying who that person was. If true, it would back up one detail of Lazar's account.
